name: Effective Meetings
goalName: How to have clear meetings, structured and well organized?
goal: In group projects, especially with a third party, meetings are essential for agreements and communication. Through previous experiences I learned that structured meetings and being punctual and consistant is important.

approach.text: Due to the origin of the literature, I am not allowed to share certain information or evidence because of confidentiality.

normalLearnings: I am able to create organized meetings with a consistant structure
I am able to divide meetings into sections, assigned to specific people
I am able to write clear effective summaries of meetings
result: Now there is more clarity and structure in the meetings, people feel more confident in the project. The group also gives a professional impression to the client.
validation: Peers gave feedback that the meetings are better now, and agreed on choices I made.
contribution: Meetings are now more effective. Other interpersonal communication is lacking however, so that will be my next point of improvement.
